break_even_formula: (101.4 - forecast Engineer days) * Engineer day rate + (15.2 - forecast Principal days) * Principal day rate - operator days * operator day rate - incremental equipment/model/other operating costs; setup and recurring coordination already included in forecast role days
test_engineer_savings: Not computed; source staffing lists 0.5 FTE Test Engineer but no test-role effort total is available.
operator_savings: Not computed; source has no recovered Operator effort baseline.

assumption_inputs.status: Planning assumptions, not observed performance or approved commitments
assumption_inputs.time_basis: Working days, eight-hour capacity day, five working days per week; no assumed overnight or weekend productivity gain
assumption_inputs.comparison_scope: The 30 sized original tickets plus explicitly additional fleet setup. Original ERP link, phone UI and release verification remain unsized and outside like-for-like savings, with dependencies retained in a separate scope register.
assumption_inputs.scenario_parameter_meaning: Execution/rework multipliers apply to new judgement estimates of agent and human work, not to original Engineer days. Capacity is an assumed available resource, not measured throughput.

recurring_fleet_coordination.rule: Reserve these within each scenario's assigned human capacity. Schedule task/setup phases using remaining capacity. Add reserved FTE times scenario elapsed working days to human effort and savings calculations as explicit recurring coordination/operations effort, including waiting periods. Per-ticket effort covers task-specific work, not this cross-fleet reserve.

assumption_inputs.role_pool_rule: Engineer, Principal and operator pools assume independently available capacity, not separate full-time hires. If roles share a person, allocations must fit individual availability and conflicting assignments must be prevented before approving dates.

physical_resources.rule: Identical physical readiness and prototype/fixture counts in all primary scenarios. Scenario target_slots counts basic development-board stations only. One prototype/plant pool is held exclusively for integration, control acceptance, dry-out and soak; a separate fixture supports provisioning. Sensitivities vary hardware readiness separately.

human_review_policy.rule: Principal ticket effort covers human approval of every merge plus engineering decisions. Increase raw ticket allowances by 50% for initial policy; never reduce review effort for stretch. Also show a sensitivity retaining 15.2 Principal days of ticket review before setup and recurring coordination.

assumption_inputs.physical_duration_rule: Target active, fixed observation and hands-on operator durations are never reduced by software scenario multipliers. Physical acceptance Engineer effort is not reduced for stretch.
assumption_inputs.decision_latency_rule: A common initial two-working-day contract/permission allowance gates product briefing and can overlap environment setup. It does not gate every setup activity or imply all stakeholder questions are answered. Sensitivity ten days; unresolved later decisions remain additional risk.

fixed_physical_duration_allowances.status: Unconfirmed allowances held constant across scenarios, not source requirements, measured durations or permission to shorten actual tests

setup_target_estimates.status: Judgement allowances include configuration plus governance/authority assignment, security boundary review, versioned task/evidence/reservation records, controlled target access and first-wave forecast analysis. Main effort comprises original configuration E2/P0.5 plus governance E1/P0.5, durable records E1/P0.25, security E0.5/P0.25, exclusivity/access E0.5/P0.25 and forecast analysis E0.5/P0.25. Enforce exclusivity through dedicated target-owning host accounts and serialised access, not ompc session leases. Suitable machine reuse assumed; purchasing lead time, quotes and generic platform development excluded. Target commissioning waits for each resource type's ready date.

cost_basis.rule: Report effort savings and break-even allowance algebraically. Do not invent currency savings. Include setup, extra equipment, model costs and ongoing operations when rates become available.
